proposals.reason: One fixed document-proxy admission and forwarding test owner, sharing synthetic origin/auth/config/request fixtures. Parameter tables cover independent route, method, path, origin, credential, family, bounded IO and cancellation guarantees. Actual document/session routes verify the same integration boundary. Top-level tests have separate names and no function exceeds80 nonblank lines; splitting only to reduce file size would duplicate fixtures and obscure the document-only session/action isolation control. Raw byte-reader behavior is already separately owned by meri-document-bounds.test.ts.
